status: design - no authoring, no read yet
why: The candidate draw is mostly noun; every comparable census (007-010) is 100% adjective. Composition alone moves the expected blended rate 1.82% -> ~3.2% with no change in authoring quality, and the comparability rule (reader_model, reader_agent) cannot see it. So the read is stratified, a control arm is authored in the same tick with the same instruments, and the 5% stop condition is applied per stratum - never to the blend. Strata are fixed here, before any fault is seen.

instruments.author: .claude/agents/family-author.md
instruments.rule: unchanged from censuses 007-011; the instrument gate must pass before grading

candidate.selection: Enricher candidates routed by candidate_families.py, cap 20, book-restricted
candidate.comparable_to: census 011 only (noun n=53, verb n=46) - a new baseline for nouns

control.selection: gate-eligible (size>=8, charged>=70%), unauthored, from data/worklist.tsv - the draw censuses 007-010 measured
control.5.3: bastardly pre-skipped (birth-status slur); halal kept with a note; the author reads the draw and may overrule either

stop_condition: any stratum over 5% stops the run for that stratum; the blended rate is reported but decides nothing
read_design: full read of the control arm (~86); candidate arm read at the census sampling rate but never fewer than 50 per stratum where the stratum allows; packets built by census_packets.py; reader sees gloss, charge, note - not which arm

what_a_result_means.control ~1.8%, candidate noun ~3%: pipeline fine; the noun number is a noun number
what_a_result_means.control ~4%+: the tick itself is off - instruments or authoring - not the candidate draw
what_a_result_means.candidate noun >5%, control fine: book-restricted small families hurt authoring; change the cap before authoring more

aggregate_with: census2_aggregate.py --arm candidate=data/families/draft-018.json --arm control=data/families/draft-018-control.json - writes by_arm, by_arm_and_pos and strata_over_threshold; the blended error_rate_pct is still written and still decides nothing. Regression: without --arm the output is identical to census-011-results.json.
